Solidworx Engineering has manufactured aluminium components since 2008 from its base in Derdepoort Smallholdings, Pretoria, offering high-pressure and gravity die casting alongside plastic injection moulding and tool, jig and die making. The company also provides precision CNC production, design, 3D printing and fabrication, giving it a wide manufacturing capability under one roof.

Having invested in its own injection moulding machinery, Solidworx manufactures moulds for plastic components as well as the components themselves, and offers post-processing services such as powder coating to finish a job completely. The business positions itself around quality, reliability and delivery that conforms to each customer's specific requirements. Based in Derdepoort Smallholdings, Pretoria, Solidworx Engineering suits manufacturers needing die casting, injection moulding, precision machining or powder coating handled by a single supplier.

SR Solutions is a 100% female-owned, BEE-accredited company founded in February 2010, providing waste management, industrial and hazardous cleaning, commercial cleaning and pest control and fumigation services from its base in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria. Its commercial cleaning covers offices, retail stores, corporate premises and small businesses, including trash removal, floor mopping and vacuuming, and desk and phone cleaning.

Alongside its cleaning and waste services, SR Solutions offers accredited, unit-standard-aligned training in waste management and industrial cleaning skills, aimed at helping frontline custodians and supervisors reach their potential. With more than a decade of experience in cleaning, waste and hygiene services, the company serves small and medium businesses, industries, corporates and government alike. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm. Based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, SR Solutions suits private and public sector clients needing cleaning, waste management or pest control handled by one accredited provider.

STADIO Higher Education's Pretoria Centurion Campus, based in Eco-Park Estate, Centurion, offers undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications across its Schools of Administration and Management, Commerce, Education, Information Technology, Law, and Fashion, Arts and Design. The campus includes an amphitheatre, a 500-seat auditorium and modern, state-of-the-art lecture theatres, supported by outdoor spaces and informal study areas for students between classes.

Undergraduate options include a Bachelor of Commerce, a Higher Certificate in Management, and Bachelor of Education degrees in Foundation Phase and Intermediate Phase teaching, while postgraduate students can pursue a Bachelor of Arts Honours in Fashion. The campus draws on an industry-aligned faculty, aiming to keep programmes connected to current workplace practice. Based in Eco-Park Estate, Centurion, the campus suits school leavers and working adults across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area looking for accredited higher education within several different fields of study.

Super Snacks is a Centurion-based manufacturer of puffed corn snack products, established in 1998 and now operating four production plants across South Africa. The company is known for its range of proprietary flavoured maize snacks, developed and produced in-house rather than contract-manufactured for other brands.

Running four separate plants rather than one central factory lets Super Snacks distribute its snack range more efficiently across different regions of the country, keeping products fresher on the shelf. The company has built this manufacturing footprint over more than 25 years in the industry. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, Super Snacks suits retailers and distributors across South Africa looking for an established, proprietary maize snack manufacturer rather than a private-label producer.

Superdecks is an outdoor timber and composite construction specialist based in East Lynne, Pretoria, with a project portfolio dating back to 2004. The company builds sun decks as home extensions or standalone structures, pool and jacuzzi decks in timber or zero-maintenance composite, and wall cladding as a modern alternative to painting a wall.

Its pergola and screen structures are built to support plant creepers for shade, with sheeting that can be added on top to make the structure waterproof. Superdecks also builds decks around ready-made DIY jacuzzi box units as well as custom-built jacuzzi baths. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, Superdecks suits homeowners wanting a sun deck, pool deck, pergola or wall cladding built by a specialist outdoor timber and composite contractor rather than a general builder.

T Sphere Geomatica is a geospatial-services company based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, registered in 2015. The company provides aerial mapping, LiDAR surveying, orthophotography and GIS data services for clients working on infrastructure, mining, urban-planning, agricultural and environmental projects.

By combining aerial survey techniques with GIS data processing, the company turns raw aerial and LiDAR capture into usable mapping and planning data for engineers, planners and environmental consultants, reducing the need for slower, more labour-intensive ground surveying on large sites. Based in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, T Sphere Geomatica suits infrastructure, mining and urban-planning projects needing accurate, up-to-date aerial mapping and geospatial data rather than relying on ground survey alone.

TAC Glass & Aluminium (Pty) Ltd is a Rosslyn-based supplier and installer of aluminium and glass doors and windows, covering sliding, pivot and folding door systems alongside aluminium, steel and uPVC window systems. The business handles both interior and front doors, as well as more specialised glass doors for a modern, high-visibility entrance.

Working directly with homeowners and contractors on supply and installation, the company quotes on projects ranging from a handful of replacement windows to multi-door folding and sliding installations for a full home renovation. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, TAC Glass & Aluminium suits homeowners and builders needing aluminium or glass doors and windows supplied and fitted by a dedicated specialist rather than a general hardware store.

Tanya's Private Entities is a registered South African holding company based in Andeon, Pretoria, founded by a qualified nephrology clinical technologist. The company acts as the primary funding hub and parent company for two specialised healthcare imprints, ClearFlow Dialysis Solutions and JT Chokoe Inc, providing them with financial, structural and operational resources.

Through these subsidiaries, the group delivers patient-centred renal care across Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga, aiming to improve patient outcomes through safe, efficient treatment backed by high-quality products and dedicated clinical service. Based in Andeon, Pretoria, Tanya's Private Entities suits healthcare professionals and patients connected to its dialysis and renal-care subsidiaries across the three provinces it serves.

Team Agent is a real estate agency with more than 30 years of experience, trading since 1990 and specialising in property sales, rentals and free appraisals. The agency has operated within Boardwalk Meander Estate for more than two decades, giving it detailed local knowledge of the estate and its surrounding lifestyle communities.

Its listings focus on carefully selected properties within luxury lifestyle estates, backed by local expertise and guidance for both buyers and sellers. Based in Boardwalk Meander Estate, Pretoria, Team Agent suits buyers and sellers within Boardwalk Meander and similar luxury estate communities looking for an agency with long-standing, specific knowledge of that market rather than a broader generalist agency.

Tech IT All is an online technology retailer based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, selling networking gear, laptops, CCTV and security equipment, storage devices and power solutions such as UPS units and solar kits. The store's range extends down to component level, including batteries, cables, antennas, RAM and networking hardware such as routers, extenders, wireless adapters and switches.

Alongside new stock, Tech IT All sells refurbished electronics such as routers and laptops at reduced prices, giving budget-conscious customers a cheaper way into networking and computing equipment. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, Tech IT All suits home users, small offices and IT installers needing networking, security or power equipment, whether buying new or looking for a more affordable refurbished option.

Tech Nation, based at the Jacaranda Centre in Rietfontein, Pretoria, builds custom gaming PCs ranging from entry-level to high-performance rigs, alongside 3D printing services and IT and console repairs. The store operates on a buy, sell, swap and trade-in model, letting customers trade in old tech rather than simply buying new.

Its stock includes pre-built gaming PCs with current-generation components, pre-owned laptops, gaming consoles and accessories, along with a range of pre-owned games across older and current console generations. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 2pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm. Based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, Tech Nation suits gamers and PC users looking for custom-built computers, console repairs or a trade-in option for their old tech.

Technomobi (Pty) Ltd is an online mobile phone retailer based in Doringkloof, Centurion, selling smartphones, tablets and smartwatches from brands including Apple, Samsung and Huawei, alongside Xiaomi devices and accessories. The store also sells certified pre-owned devices backed by a one-year warranty, and an "unboxed" range of opened-packaging stock that has been expert tested and sold as good as new.

Customers can split the cost of a screen repair into instalments through PayFlex, PayJustNow or Float, and the store offers nationwide delivery with seven-day, hassle-free returns on eligible products. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm, closed weekends. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, Technomobi suits customers wanting new, certified pre-owned or unboxed mobile devices delivered anywhere in South Africa.

Tectix Group is a software and digital-transformation company based in Eco Park, Centurion, offering custom software engineering, cloud adoption and migration, DevOps and infrastructure, and cybersecurity services. Its development work covers end-to-end custom software, from purpose-built systems designed around a client's specific challenges to responsive digital platforms and e-commerce solutions built on platforms including AWS, Azure and Salesforce.

Beyond development, Tectix Group offers data engineering and analytics, business and system analysis, project and programme management, and management consulting, alongside staff augmentation for clients needing extra technical capacity on a project. Based in Eco Park, Centurion, Tectix Group suits corporates needing software development, cloud migration or technical consulting handled by a single digital transformation partner.

TECWENI SOLUTIONS is an engineering firm based in Mayville, Pretoria, registered since 2017, offering prototype design and manufacturing alongside production design work. The company solves what it describes as both known and unknown engineering problems, taking a project from initial prototype through to a manufactured production design.

Its automation design and development work integrates mechanical and electronic hardware with bespoke software, producing personalised, customised monitoring and data-handling systems rather than off-the-shelf automation. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm. Based in Mayville, Pretoria, TECWENI SOLUTIONS suits clients needing a custom prototype, automation system or monitoring solution engineered specifically for their equipment rather than adapted from a generic product.

Teka Famba is a car rental company based in Thatchfield, Centurion, renting out vehicles ranging from hatchbacks through to SUVs, bakkies and minibuses. The company doesn't require a credit card to rent a vehicle, and its deposits are kept low and refunded within 48 hours of the car being returned.

Booking works through a simple three-step process: customers filter available cars by seats, transmission and fuel type, reserve instantly online, then collect the vehicle at an agreed pickup location, with pickup and delivery available rather than requiring an in-person office visit. Based in Thatchfield, Centurion, Teka Famba suits renters who want a straightforward, low-deposit car rental without the credit card and paperwork requirements of a larger international rental chain.

The Boyz Travel Merchants is a full-service leisure and corporate travel agency based in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, booking flights, accommodation and holiday packages for its clients. Its leisure packages range from beach and bush breaks through to cruises, guided tours and romantic getaways, covering a wide spread of holiday styles rather than a single niche.

On the corporate side, the agency handles business travel bookings, giving companies in and around Midstream Estate a local travel agent rather than relying solely on an online booking platform. Based at The Square in Midstream Estate, The Boyz Travel Merchants suits both individual holidaymakers planning a leisure trip and businesses needing corporate travel arranged by a dedicated travel agency.

The Crazy Store at Queenswood Quarter is a variety retailer selling toys, gifts, home goods and party supplies at budget-friendly prices, on the corner of Stead Avenue and Fontana Road in Queenswood, Pretoria. The store offers in-store shopping with card payments, and the shopping centre location includes wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking.

As part of the wider Crazy Store chain, the Queenswood branch carries the group's standard mix of discount household goods, giving shoppers a budget option for toys, gifts and party supplies without needing to visit a larger shopping mall. Open daily from 9am to 6pm, The Crazy Store Queenswood Quarter suits families and shoppers in Queenswood looking for an affordable, convenient destination for everyday gifts, party supplies and home items.

The Digital Colab is a digital marketing consultancy based near Akasia, Pretoria, helping small businesses build and optimise their digital presence through strategic marketing, branding and design. The consultancy draws on behavioural-economics and customer-experience principles, aiming to apply insight into how customers actually make decisions rather than relying on generic marketing templates.

Having worked across both large companies and smaller businesses, the consultancy identified a specific gap: many small businesses underinvest in their digital footprint, and those that do invest often don't use their digital platforms to get optimal results. Based near Akasia, Pretoria, The Digital Colab suits small businesses wanting to build a more professional digital presence with marketing grounded in behavioural insight rather than guesswork.

The Femalexx Kitchen is a bespoke catering business based in East Lynne, Pretoria, offering tailored menus for private and corporate events, including special dietary requests such as vegan, gluten-free and organic options. The business caters on-site for exclusive gatherings, and its product range extends to cakes, from a simple eight-inch cake through to full wedding cakes, along with platters, harvest tables, cheese boards and snack boards.

Alongside its catering work, the business produces its own organic condiment line, Umnotho Organics, reflecting its stated focus on sourcing quality, locally sourced ingredients. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, The Femalexx Kitchen suits clients planning a private party, corporate function or wedding who want a tailored menu and cake made to order rather than a standard set catering package.

The Lion Match Company has manufactured and distributed personal care and household products since 1905, with a facility in Rosslyn, Pretoria. Its brand portfolio spans Lion safety matches, Lion shoe polish, Price's household candles, and the Sylko range of household and disposable occasion products.

On the personal care side, the group's brands include Duel for male grooming, Loving Touch for female grooming, Comfitex feminine and adult sanitary care, and Cherubs baby care products, alongside a beauty care range and a gifting and decor line. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, The Lion Match Company suits retailers and distributors stocking a long-established South African range of household, personal care and gifting brands.

The Property Boutique is a property investment specialist based in Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, Centurion, offering buying, selling, building and investment services. The company helps buyers purchase property below market value, and offers sellers a fast cash purchase option for those who need a quick sale rather than a lengthy listed process.

On the investment side, The Property Boutique runs an investor club, giving members a structured way to put money into property investment ventures alongside the company's construction and development arm. Based in Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, Centurion, The Property Boutique suits both buyers looking for a below-market-value purchase and sellers or investors wanting a faster, more structured property transaction than a traditional estate agency offers.

The Way Recovery is an addiction treatment centre in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria, offering a medically monitored detox followed by a 28-day residential programme and outpatient follow-up care. Treatment is built around the Matrix Model, combining the 12-step method with other therapeutic approaches including motivational interviewing and cognitive behavioural therapy.

The centre is registered and fully licensed, and is accepted by most medical aids as rehabilitation falls under Prescribed Minimum Benefits in South Africa. Alongside its Waterkloof Ridge centre, the organisation also operates a second centre in Garsfontein, and residents have access to on-site accommodation, gardens and a pool during treatment. Based in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria, The Way Recovery suits individuals and families seeking a licensed, medical-aid-recognised addiction treatment programme for drug, alcohol or gambling addiction.

Thrive CFO is a cloud-based accounting and virtual CFO firm based in Heritage Hill Estate, Centurion, serving consultancies, agencies and professional-services businesses. Its client base includes event managers, management consultants, financial planners and IT consultants, as well as professional firms such as architects, attorneys and insurance brokers.

The firm's services cover monthly bookkeeping and accounting, payroll, virtual CFO and financial-advisory work, secretarial services and HR support, delivered through cloud platforms including Xero and Syft Analytics. Because it works only with a select group of businesses at a time, Thrive CFO positions itself around a closer, more empathetic advisory relationship rather than high client-volume compliance work. Based in Heritage Hill Estate, Centurion, Thrive CFO suits consultancies and professional-services firms wanting a cloud-based virtual CFO rather than a traditional in-house finance team.

TJ Mahapa Accountants is an independent accounting and tax firm based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, offering payroll administration, bookkeeping, tax return submissions and company secretarial and business registration services. The firm also compiles financial statements based on information provided by a client's management, and carries out independent reviews of annual financial statements for close corporations, private companies and non-profit organisations.

On the payroll side, the firm handles the administration of payroll and employee regulations rather than leaving it to an in-house bookkeeper, and clients can choose to outsource some or all of their accounting requirements while staying in control of their business decisions. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, TJ Mahapa Accountants suits small and medium businesses, close corporations and non-profits needing payroll, bookkeeping, tax or company secretarial services from an independent local firm.

Tramigo South Africa provides fleet management and vehicle-tracking solutions, including GPS tracking, dashcam video monitoring, push-to-talk communication and fleet management software, as part of a global network powering more than a million connected assets. The company's AI-assisted video monitoring reviews road, cabin and field events, giving fleet managers recorded evidence rather than relying on driver reports alone.

Its combined hardware, software and connectivity offering serves the transport, logistics, mining, and vehicle finance and insurance industries, and the company also runs a reseller programme for partners wanting to offer Tramigo's tracking and fleet management products under their own service. Based in Tijger Valley, Pretoria, Tramigo South Africa suits fleet operators and vehicle finance providers needing GPS tracking, dashcam monitoring and fleet software from one integrated provider.

Transpharm is a pharmaceutical wholesaler founded by retail pharmacists in 1970 and now part of the Shoprite Group, distributing ethical, over-the-counter, veterinary and surgical products nationwide to pharmacies, practitioners and medical businesses. With more than 20 years in operation under its current structure, the wholesaler offers a broad product range backed by reliable delivery and efficient order handling.

Customers can settle accounts using NFC mobile payments as well as standard credit and debit cards, a convenience aimed at professional buyers processing frequent orders. Based in the Bronberrik area of Centurion, Transpharm Pretoria serves pharmacies, medical practitioners and other healthcare businesses across the region needing a single wholesale supplier for pharmaceutical, veterinary and surgical stock.

Truteq Wireless (Pty) Ltd develops telecommunications and connectivity platforms for mobile network operators and financial service providers, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion. Its product range includes a Diameter signalling platform, an API gateway and service triggers, alongside USSD and smart SMS messaging infrastructure used to power mobile banking services.

These signalling and messaging platforms sit behind the scenes of services many mobile users rely on daily, such as USSD banking menus and SMS-based notifications, giving carriers and banks the infrastructure layer rather than the customer-facing app itself. Serving carriers across Africa and the Asia-Pacific region, Truteq positions its technology as built for smart connectivity that keeps working reliably at scale. Based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, Truteq Wireless suits mobile network operators and financial service providers needing signalling, USSD or mobile banking infrastructure.

Tshitadingaka Contractors is a Level 1 B-BBEE, 100% Black-owned civil engineering and construction firm founded in 2005, based in Brummeria, Pretoria East. The firm specialises in building construction, pipeline installation, and infrastructure and platform work, alongside fencing and routine road maintenance.

Combining building construction with civil infrastructure work such as pipelines and road maintenance lets the firm take on a broader mix of municipal and private-sector projects than a company focused on a single discipline. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, Tshitadingaka Contractors suits government bodies and private clients needing civil engineering, construction, pipeline or road maintenance work from a Level 1 B-BBEE contractor.

Tshwane Trusses & Timber manufactures and supplies engineered timber and steel roof trusses from its base in Booysens, Pretoria, offering CAD design, engineering support and on-site installation. The company is ITC-SA certified and draws on more than two decades of combined technical experience among its team.

Its hybrid steel-and-timber trusses are built for demanding projects needing both durability and economy, while standard timber trusses suit cost-effective residential spans with less on-site cutting and waste. The company backs its truss systems with a warranty of more than 20 years and has completed more than 500 projects for builders across the SADC region. Based in Booysens, Pretoria, Tshwane Trusses & Timber suits developers, builders and homeowners needing engineered roof trusses designed and installed by a certified specialist.

Tsoelopele Leadership Consulting is a 100% Black-owned and 50% Black-female-owned training provider established on 2 October 2015, based in Val de Grace, Pretoria. The provider offers Office Skills, Management Skills and QCTO occupational skills programmes, delivered through face-to-face training, MS Teams or e-learning formats depending on a client's needs.

Accredited with PSETA, Tsoelopele also delivers historical qualifications programmes for learners needing to complete older, legacy courses no longer offered elsewhere. The provider positions its mission around nurturing career aspirations and developing talent to strengthen both individuals and the wider community. Based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, Tsoelopele Leadership Consulting suits organisations and individuals needing accredited office, management or occupational skills training in a flexible delivery format.

Turkish Table is a strictly halal Turkish restaurant in Hatfield, Pretoria, serving traditional kebabs, wraps and dips cooked over open-flame grills. The kitchen also makes its own Baklava and Kunefe on the premises, giving diners an authentic Turkish dessert alongside the savoury menu.

Being strictly halal and cooking everything from the grills and desserts in-house gives the restaurant a more specialist, traditional focus than a general Middle Eastern or Mediterranean takeaway. It is open every day from 10am to 8:30pm. Based in Hatfield, Pretoria, Turkish Table suits diners looking for authentic, halal-certified Turkish grilled food and traditional desserts rather than a generalised kebab shop.

TWK Insurance Pretoria is a branch of the TWK financial services group, offering short-term and long-term insurance, medical aid and gap cover, and crop and plantation insurance from its Parktown Estate office. The branch also provides fiduciary services and funeral administration, giving clients a broader spread of financial protection than a standalone short-term insurer.

Its short-term insurance offering is backed by 14 underwriting and claims mandates with major insurers, supporting quicker turnaround times on claims, and the group offers a 24-hour emergency service alongside specialist crop-damage assessments for both its own clients and other brokers. Based in Parktown Estate, Pretoria, TWK Insurance suits individuals, farmers and businesses needing short-term, long-term, crop or plantation insurance handled by one broker with agricultural sector expertise.

TYREWORX Dastek Monument Park is a tyre dealer, fitment and service centre in Monument Park, Pretoria, offering multiple tyre brands alongside shock absorber, battery, brake and suspension repairs. The centre also handles mag wheel repairs, run-flat tyre fitment, wheel alignment, and suspension components such as ball joints, CV joints and tie-rod ends.

Customers get free nitrogen tyre top-ups as part of the centre's standard service, and the branch runs regular promotions and online quote discounts for both new and returning customers. It is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based in Monument Park, Pretoria, TYREWORX Dastek suits drivers needing tyres, wheel alignment or suspension and brake work handled at one service centre.

UNATSHO TRADING PTY LTD is a Centurion-based reseller of electronic and ICT equipment, supplying biometric access control and time-and-attendance solutions, IP-based CCTV, wireless networking and audio-visual systems. The company also installs boom gates and electric fences, covering both the IT and physical access-control sides of a property's security.

Beyond hardware supply and installation, the business offers company branding such as logos, letterheads and business cards, and web design services including website builds and email account setup, aimed at adding value beyond its core electronic and ICT supply work. Based in Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion, UNATSHO TRADING suits SMMEs needing ICT equipment, security systems and basic branding or web design handled by one technology reseller.

Urban Mzansi is an online marketplace based in Olievenhoutbosch, Pretoria, connecting South African local brands and independent entrepreneurs with shoppers across the country. The platform lists fashion, footwear, accessories, beauty products and handmade goods, giving small, independent sellers a shared storefront rather than requiring each to build their own online shop.

By aggregating multiple local brands in one place, Urban Mzansi gives shoppers a single site to browse a range of South African-made products, with nationwide delivery on orders. Based in Olievenhoutbosch, Pretoria, Urban Mzansi suits shoppers wanting to support local South African entrepreneurs and small fashion, beauty or handmade-goods brands from one online marketplace.

Van Technologies is a managed IT services provider based in Eco Park, Centurion, offering cloud hosting, Microsoft 365 deployment and VoIP phone systems alongside on-site installations such as network cabling, servers, firewalls and security cameras. Its cloud hosting runs on SSD-powered servers with 99.9% uptime, backed by managed firewall protection and daily automated backups.

The company's Microsoft 365 service covers everything from user setup and licensing through to full migrations from legacy systems, while its VoIP offering includes both onsite and cloud-hosted PBX with call routing. Support is delivered under SLA-backed contracts, giving clients a guaranteed response standard rather than ad hoc support. Based in Eco Park, Centurion, Van Technologies suits businesses needing cloud hosting, Microsoft 365 migration, VoIP or on-site IT infrastructure managed under one support agreement.

Verita Brand Set Building is a custom set design and building company based in Weavind Park, Pretoria, specialising in set building and installation for the film, television, theatre and events industries. The company's work spans audio-visual installation, design and renovation services alongside its core set-building work.

Describing itself as a multi-faceted company, Verita Brand works across the entertainment and marketing industries, building physical sets and installations for productions and events rather than offering a single standard package. Based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, Verita Brand Set Building suits production companies, event organisers and marketing teams needing a custom set or installation built and fitted on site.

Village Flavour is a restaurant and takeaway in Sunnyside, Pretoria, serving authentic African cuisine alongside organic, home-made dishes including fish, steaks and chicken. The restaurant offers free on-site parking, a practical detail for a busy inner-city suburb where parking can otherwise be difficult to find.

The venue also has space available for parties and private events, letting groups book the restaurant for a celebration rather than only dining as walk-in customers. Based on the corner of Reitz and Vos Streets in Sunnyside, Pretoria, Village Flavour suits diners looking for authentic African and organic home-style cooking, as well as groups wanting a venue for a private function.

Vinova Communications is a marketing agency based in Glen Lauriston, Centurion, offering website development, digital marketing, brand and corporate identity development, public relations and corporate video production. The agency works across entertainment, education, medical, aesthetic and corporate industries, giving it experience adapting a campaign or brand identity to quite different sectors.

Combining website and brand identity work with public relations and video production lets the agency handle both the visual brand and the ongoing media and communications side of a client's marketing. Based in Glen Lauriston, Centurion, Vinova Communications suits businesses across a range of industries wanting their website, branding, PR and video content managed by a single agency.

Vision Dynamics is a multi-service drone and photography brand based in Florauna, Pretoria, organised into five divisions covering UAV operations, photography, drone sales, maintenance and training. Its UAV division serves agriculture, construction, mining, and farm and lodge clients, offering aerial mapping and media work across these four industry hubs.

The photography division covers ground photography, video, studio work, real estate, events and promotional content, while the sales and maintenance divisions handle equipment recommendations, starter packages and drone repair after mechanical, software, fall or water damage. Its training division guides pilots through the licensing pathway alongside radio, flight and operational skills development. Based in Florauna, Pretoria, Vision Dynamics suits agricultural, construction and mining clients needing drone services, as well as individuals wanting to buy, repair or get trained on a drone.

Vision Works Lynnwood Lane is an optometry practice based at the Lynnwood Retail Centre in Equestria, Pretoria, offering eye examinations, prescription glasses, and designer and reading sunglasses. The practice fits specialised lens coatings including blue light filtering and polarised options, as well as Miyosmart smart lenses aimed at managing myopia progression in children.

The practice runs ongoing promotions such as free eye exams for pensioners and free eye tests for children, alongside contact lens promotions and seasonal discounts on designer sunglasses. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 3pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm. Based in Equestria, Pretoria, Vision Works Lynnwood Lane suits patients needing an eye test, prescription eyewear or specialised lenses from a practice offering extended weekend hours.

VP Electrical Contractors is a 100% Black-owned electrical contracting company founded in 1990, based in East Lynne, Pretoria. The company provides residential and commercial electrical installation and maintenance services, handling everything from household wiring work through to larger commercial electrical projects for offices, shops and industrial premises.

With more than three decades in the trade, the company has completed projects across Limpopo, Gauteng and the Eastern Cape, giving it experience beyond a single regional market and a long track record to draw on for new installation work. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, VP Electrical Contractors suits residential and commercial clients across these provinces needing an established, Black-owned electrical contractor for installation or maintenance work.

Waterkloof is a guest house on Albert Street in Waterkloof, Pretoria, offering 24 guest rooms furnished in teak and leather, each with air-conditioning and fibre Wi-Fi. Room categories range from King and Executive Suites through to Family Rooms, Standard Rooms, Self-Catering Rooms and Budget Double Rooms, giving guests a choice across different budgets and group sizes.

The guest house has a heated outdoor pool and garden with a braai area, and also hosts conferences and functions, with its own conferencing and function rates and a shuttle service available for guests. Based in Waterkloof, Pretoria, the guest house suits business travellers needing a conference venue as well as leisure guests wanting a quieter, garden-set alternative to a large hotel.

Wellness Warehouse Southdowns is the Southdowns Shopping Centre branch of the national health and wellness retailer, stocking supplements, vitamins, fitness and recovery products, beauty and personal-care lines, nutrition and food, household wellness and lifestyle items. Like other branches, it carries the chain's skincare, haircare, sports and recovery and wellness-essentials ranges, so shoppers can cover a full wellness shop in one visit rather than several specialist stores.

The shop is at Shop 41, Southdowns Shopping Centre, on the corner of John Vorster and Karee Streets in Irene, Centurion. It supports in-store shopping as well as Click & Collect, with same-day collection available subject to stock. It suits shoppers across Irene and Centurion looking for vitamins, supplements, specialist dietary products or everyday personal care from a local health and vitamin store that also offers online-order collection.

Willards Foods is a snack food manufacturer based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, producing a family-focused range that includes Cheese Curls and Flings, Big Korn Bites, Crinkle Cut chips, Flanagan's Irish Kettle fried chips and Cheasnaks. The brand is part of the AVI group, a South African consumer-goods company with a portfolio of established local food and beverage brands.

Willards positions its snacks around sharing and everyday enjoyment, aiming to produce a range that appeals to the whole family rather than a single age group or taste profile. The brand has built this reputation over several decades in the South African snack market. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, Willards Foods supplies retailers across South Africa needing an established, nationally recognised snack brand for their shelves.

WL Engineering is an electrical and mechanical engineering contractor founded in 1994 and based in Salieshoek, Silverton, Pretoria. The company handles power network design, along with the maintenance and repair of electrical equipment for industrial and commercial clients across the Pretoria and Tshwane area.

Its core work extends to the construction and reconstruction of power supply systems, covering projects from new power network installations through to upgrading or rebuilding existing infrastructure that has reached the end of its working life. Based in Salieshoek, Pretoria, WL Engineering suits industrial and commercial clients needing power network design, construction or ongoing electrical equipment maintenance from an established contractor with three decades in the field.

Wonderboom South Emergency Plumbers is a 24/7 emergency plumbing service handling burst pipes, water leaks, blocked drains, toilet malfunctions and faulty hot water systems for residents and businesses in Wonderboom South. Beyond emergency call-outs, the business offers full residential and commercial plumbing, including rough-in and finishing plumbing, water purification system installation and repair, and heat pump installation and repair.

Its drainage work covers pipe installation and relining, water leak detection and drain cleaning, while bathroom plumbing includes sink, shower, bath and handicap-accessible bathroom installation and full bathroom remodelling. With more than seven years of experience, the business serves homeowners, real estate agents, restaurant owners and property managers. Based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, the service suits residents and businesses needing both urgent emergency plumbing repairs and planned bathroom or drainage work from the same provider.
